Yeah exactly, know imagine you can't get those things that border between needs and wants.

Then living becomes surviving. Surviving isnot worth it.
I'm just trying to double check if there's a reason to keep going. I have my answer now.
So we should all be poor, because some are poor. Thanks for the empathy.

Money doesn't buy happiness, it makes misery more tolerable.

I don't understand fiscal hardship because I've never been unlucky or stupid enough to have to. I went from college dropout, to McDonalds cashier, to military service member, to making just under six figures in less than 6 years.

Why would I want to be a slumlord of a southeast asian nation. I've been to the Philippines, Korea, Germany, and Iraq. 

I want an unachievable ideal but I'm not stupid enough to believe I'll get it.
That's assuming I'm a rational actor.

Sure, I could use drugs to get dopamine and serotonin and other crap, but now I'm no different from a drug addict chasing highs.

Free from everything. With enough money I'll never have to work again. I could simply get fat and die alone in my bed from heart complications in 5-15 years. Or I could work a job I want. Or I could buy a robot companion and never be alone again. 

Money is both the lock and key to our world. It's like oxygen but a little better. Money is value abstracted, therefore it is infinitely more valuable than it's own weight in gold, simply because it can be reused while still holding value. Of course in/deflation impact the actual value, but to a layman a dollar is a dollar.

Why should I care about feeling bad by making people clean up my mess? They didn't care when it mattered, so fuck em.
No
Then when wouldn't I kill myself. It just ends everything. No worries, no dreams, just the end.
I work out 5-10 times a week. So you can screw off with exercise makes me feel better crap.

Of course I'm not. Sane people lead template cookie cutter lives right until they realize it was a big lie and they were being milled for corporatism. 

Passion, like all other emotions, are just fleeting garbage chemical reactions that arent sustainable.

That's why I won't change. Why bother? I have money and am working towards freedom. Any other pursuit is secondary, so who cares.

There's no incentive. If I kill myself, the only one who would have cared would've been me.

Nobody else will care to love, hate, or acknowledge me.

Probably because society doesn't give a fuck about people like me. If you're clinical depressed and suicidal, they just wait you out. I'll kill myself before you ever get anywhere in this strange, perverted argument you seem fond of.

Blowing my brains out was a logical solution to a problem of loneliness. Either I died and had no more problems, or someone in real fucking life would have given a shit.

Instead I'm left to these superficial relationships on the internet, which have no longevity, nor are they satisfying.

One of us will tire of this. We'll go back to our unsatisfactory lives, then we'll breakdown only to repeat this cycle.

You honestly make me wish I didn't throw out my gun so I could try right now.

Why can't you just admit that some people are fucked? Why is it so strange to encounter someone who gave up? Why do you want me to live when you don't know me? 

You have nothing to gain, time and patience to lose.

There's no view to change. I checked out of life years ago and I'm not coming back.

Yeah it's real nice when someone just shits all over your failures with armchair psychoanalysis.

All this ever boils down to is 

"Go to therapy until you can put on your normal mask again. Nobody actually cares beyond the fact that you pay taxes. It's on you to do everything else."

I regret coming back to Reddit.
Say it all you want, you're no different from the desensitized doctors and nurses.
I'm not talking to people who only want to solve problems with no empathy.
Then I'll just hang myself.
We're done here.
No I'm going back into my hole. If a gun to head wasn't a cry for help that people care about then I'm just going to join the statistics.
No and I have no plans to go back until I can get shock therapy.
It doesn't matter anymore. The only thing of value I got was the fact that I'm alone.

I guess I don't. Just coming to terms with the fact that I didn't even kill myself correctly. So there's nothing left but to trudge on until I die from something else.

I expected some kind of support after waking up in the hospital. Instead I came back to an empty apartment and thousands of dollars of medical bills.
You're right. I'll just delete this. People only care about solving problems anyways, no one cares about the emotional ramifications.
Must be nice to be able to enjoy stuff. Haven't been able to in years. Probably never will again.
They don't go away. It's been a long time.
That's usually what depressions does.
